# Transaction APIs

You can use our APIs to perform various tasks related to making payouts. You can perform most of these actions from the [RazorpayX Dashboard](https://x.razorpay.com/auth) as well.

## List of APIs
The table below lists the various Transaction APIs and gives a brief description of each API:

API | Description
---
[Fetch all Transactions](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/transactions/fetch-all.md) | API to retrieve details of all the transactions.
---
[Fetch Transaction with ID](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/api/x/transactions/fetch-with-id.md)| API to retrieve details of one transaction using its ID.
